external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: A backend operated by another team that calls the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The text states that two of the calling services are in a different cloud.

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who publishes new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.notes: The source says: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server and updated by ML engineers.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response, including raw prompts for debugging.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call gateway
data_flows.description: A calling service sends an inference request to the inference gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and we have never expired one.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards an inference request to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no auth between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access. The source says it does not believe anything verifies that the artifact has not been swapped.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The inference gateway writes every request and response to the inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: requests and responses, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: An ML engineer publishes new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: different cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud environment containing two of the calling services.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two of the calling services are in a different cloud

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store, intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.notes: The model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The service is described as a FastAPI service, which presents an HTTP application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store holds personally identifiable and financial data.
assumptions.basis: It contains features associated with individual customers, including spend bands.
